groups.title: Section A · 第 1 篇 · 1–2 题
groups.material:
A terrified cat has survived a five-mile round trip under the engine cover of a car on a school run. The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
Mr King's wife said her husband had come "running in" and was "shouting for me to come have a look".
"We weren't even sure it was alive, so I gently pushed it with a stick to check it was breathing and saw it was a terrified little cat. It reversed even further into the engine and was stuck. I tried to reach it, but it was too far down and there wasn't any way I could get it out."
Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the four-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour.

groups.title: Section A · 第 2 篇 · 3–4 题
groups.material:
In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville. The Games are coming back for the first time in five years. The event will take place at Methodist University.
Event organizer Benjamin Kowalczyk says he's excited that athletes will get a chance to come back and demonstrate their abilities. Organizers expect about 100 athletes will come out to compete in Fayetteville. They will have a variety of events to choose from, including running, throwing, and jumping. There will also be a fun tent for children. Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
For anyone who wants to help make this year's Games a massive success, there are still opportunities to volunteer for Fayetteville's Special Olympics. Organizers encourage them to visit the Games' website to sign up.

groups.title: Section A · 第 3 篇 · 5–7 题
groups.material:
A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer.
The Swiss firm had argued its gold-wrapped chocolate rabbit deserved copyright protection from a similar product sold by the budget supermarket.
Switzerland's highest court agreed and overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court that had sided with the supermarket. It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted. It could be melted for use in other products.
It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers. The Swiss manufacturer's rabbit has a red bow and bell, while the German supermarket's has a green bow and bell. The colour of the wrapper is similar, as are the illustrations of the features.
The chocolate company has been to court before to protect its popular chocolate treat. Last year, a German federal court said the shade of the gold wrapping was also protected.

groups.title: Section B · 第 1 篇 · 8–11 题
groups.material:
M: Can you please hand me that book over there? It has instructions for making a winter bean salad. My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner. He's vegetarian, so I need to make a lot of vegetable dishes.
W: He only eats vegetables, no meat? That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet. How can he get enough protein? What does he do to strengthen his muscles and all that?
M: Apparently that's no problem. He's explained this to me when we first met. He eats a variety of different vegetables and nuts, especially those with high amounts of protein.
W: It sounds a bit difficult, but he's done his research I suppose. What's his reasoning for being vegetarian? Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?
M: He's an animal activist. He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals. He's even written to his state senator about the torture of dolphins in sea parks. He says that keeping animals in zoos and parks causes them great distress.
W: That's a little gloomy, but I can understand that to a point. Not all zoos and animal parks have the most favorable conditions, but without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals and their environments. Besides, I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game.
M: Honestly, I agree, but just don't let him hear you say that. He's the spokesperson for his local animal rights group.

groups.title: Section B · 第 2 篇 · 12–15 题
groups.material:
W: Did you see that television program on air travel last night?
M: Yes. The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting. I was surprised that the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey and avoiding sleeping on the plane.
W: I was too, as I read an article on the subject in the past that suggested the opposite. It claimed that it was important not to miss meals and that taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone.
M: Well, the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance. Jetlag is a big problem for me and has been for the last few years, even though I never suffered from it before.
W: Well, she did say that jetlag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well. My problem is I'm afraid to fly.
M: Oh, I didn't know that. Actually, my mother is terrified of airplanes to the point where she can't even fly, so our family vacations were always by car or train.
W: I'm not as bad as that. I just get anxious before I fly and feel nervous the whole time we're in the air, which is why I was hoping the television program would cover that topic more than it did.
M: Yeah. That segment was too brief, especially as so many people have that problem. She said 20% of people are afraid to fly.
W: Actually, it was a quarter of people, so the problem really is widespread and deserves attention.

groups.title: Section C · 第 1 篇 · 16–18 题
groups.material:
The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user experience design, to which my response is always that nothing can substitute real-world experience.
Building the skills required of a user experience designer takes time, patience, and commitment. Higher education is a great way to equip yourself with some core skills, but it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face with clients' work. In other words, being proficient with a design tool and a few methods doesn't make you a user experience designer. There simply isn't a one-size-fits-all process.
Being effective requires adaptability — something you don't really learn in school, much less in a 6-month training camp. It's gained through experience on the job and learning what's appropriate given the needs of the project.
I found my way to user experience through graphic design and slowly over many different roles and experiences. That led me to become a user experience designer. It took time and commitment to continue to pursue roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me. That's not to say that I think my path is the only one. But once again, nothing can substitute real-world experience. You can start anywhere as long as you know your end goal and you commit to actively pursuing opportunities to learn and grow along the way.

groups.title: Section C · 第 2 篇 · 19–21 题
groups.material:
When planning for this year, our principal asked what needed to change to engage students more in their learning. I responded in a whisper "flexible seating", thinking about our then-current classroom. It had rows of desks with blue chairs and nameplates reminding each student where they should be sitting.
This began a journey to transform our practice and challenge the ways of learning for a group of Year 6 students used to sitting in desks and rows for years.
Flexible seating has been defined as movable furniture to create an engaging learning environment. It is a shift in practice from being teacher-focused to student-focused learning. For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks and introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement.
The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior and reduce distraction from the teacher. Teachers tend to still use this format because of either the need to control students or the belief that the teacher is the most important person in the room.
Now our students have a range of different seating options, including a floor desk, couches, stools, bean bags, and the traditional desk-and-chair.
From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions. It is a win for all concerned.

groups.title: Section C · 第 3 篇 · 22–25 题
groups.material:
Dozens of British students arriving for their first day of school on Tuesday were sent home over their shoes. About 30 students were turned away from Taverham High School in Norfolk, England. Headteacher, Dr Roger Harris, confirmed that this was due to a change in the school's uniform policy. Harris, who became headteacher this year, said he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June.
The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living. Nearly all British schools have uniforms. They cost parents an average of £337 per year for each secondary school child.
According to the new rules, students of Taverham are required to wear smart black shoes appropriate for the workplace, Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior. But for some parents, the school's restrictions are an unnecessary burden.
As annual inflation climbs over 10%, many households are on tight budgets. Private rental prices in Britain rose 3.2% over the 12 months to July 2022, the largest jump since 2016. Soaring energy bills have made things worse.
Lucinda May, mum of a Taverham student, said that she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy her child the correct pair of shoes. May said that the school's uniform policy showed the lack of regard for parents dealing with the high cost of living.

questions.prompt: Where was the black cat found?
options: Outside the office of a charity foundation.
Inside the car of David King's neighbour.
Under the engine cover of a man's car.
At the gate of a grade school in Kent.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Where was the black cat found? 

 【翻译】 这只黑猫是在哪里被发现的? 
 A)  在一家慈善基金会的办公室外面。 
 B)  在David King邻居的车内。 
 C)  在一名男子汽车的引擎盖下面。 
 D)  在Kent一所小学的大门口。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） Under the engine cover of a man's car. 
 【定位】 P1 The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent. 
 这只黑猫是在大卫·金送孙子上学后、决定检查机油时，被发现蜷缩在他汽车的引擎盖下面的。 

 【信号】 found ＋ 地点介词短语 。答案句的信号是动词 found 紧跟一个表地点的介词短语 found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car——题干问 Where… found，原文恰好出现 found ＋『在哪儿』，这就是承载答案的那一句。 

 【替换】 under the engine cover of David King's car ↔ Under the engine cover of a man's car. 人名换成泛称 a man 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项把后文出现的 UK charity Cats Protection 里的 charity 一词搬来，编成『慈善机构门口』这个地点。可录音里 charity 只用来说明谁救的猫，从没说猫是在慈善机构门口被发现的，属听到 charity 就想选的原词陷阱。  借用原文：Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection 

 B) 张冠李戴 选项把末段的 Mr King's neighbour（邻居）搬来，说猫是在『邻居的车里』被发现。但邻居在录音里是猫的主人、出现在结局处，发现猫的车是金先生自己的车，把发现地点安到邻居车上是张冠李戴。  借用原文：reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour 

 D) 原词陷阱 选项抓住原文的 school in Kent，把『学校门口』说成发现地点。可录音里 school 是金先生送孙子去的地方、是事情发生前的背景，猫是他送完孙子、回来做机油检查时才在引擎盖下被发现的，发现地不是学校门口。  借用原文：after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent

questions.prompt: What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report?
options: It got reunited with its owner.
It was injured during the rescue.
It became a pet of Mr King's grandson.
It was placed in the care of a UK charity.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What do we learn about the cat at the end of the news report? 

 【翻译】 关于这只猫,新闻报道最后我们了解到什么? 
 A)  它与主人团聚了。 
 B)  它在救援过程中受伤了。 
 C)  它成为了King先生孙子的宠物。 
 D)  它被交由一家英国慈善机构照料。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） It got reunited with its owner. 
 【定位】 P4 Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the four-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr King's neighbour. 
 在英国慈善机构『猫咪保护』救援之后，这只四岁的猫最终与它的主人——金先生的邻居——团聚了。 

 【信号】 末段＋later标结局 。本句是录音最末一段、且含时间词 later，正对应题干的 at the end；新闻的结果通常落在最后一句，later reunited 直接交代了猫的最终下场，是答案句。 

 【替换】 reunited with its owner ↔ It got reunited with its owner. 近乎原句的同义重述 

 【排除】 B) 未提及 选项说猫『在救援中受伤』，但录音从头到尾只字未提受伤，末段只说被救后团聚。它利用第3段 terrified（受惊）、stuck（卡住）等词让人联想到猫很惨，进而脑补成『受伤』，实属过度推断、原文未提。 
 C) 张冠李戴 选项把第1段的 grandson（孙子）搬来，说猫成了金先生孙子的宠物。可孙子只在『送孙子上学』的背景里出现，录音末段明说猫团聚的对象是主人即邻居，不是被孙子养，属张冠李戴。  借用原文：after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent 

 D) 原词陷阱 选项说猫『被交由英国一家慈善机构照管』，盗用了末段 UK charity Cats Protection 这个真出现的机构。但录音里 charity 是负责『救援』的一方，救完之后猫是团聚而非留在机构照管，把过程中的救援者说成最终归宿，差在结局。  借用原文：Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection

questions.prompt: What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month?
options: The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University.
The first important political event in the next five years.
The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games.
The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What will Fayetteville witness in less than a month? 

 【翻译】 不到一个月后，Fayetteville 将见证什么? 
 A)  Methodist University 的百年校庆庆典。 
 B)  未来五年中的第一个重要政治活动。 
 C)  特殊奥林匹克春季运动会的开幕式。 
 D)  今年奥运会金牌得主的重聚。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games. 
 【定位】 P1 In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville. 
 不到一个月后，特殊奥林匹克运动会春季赛事将重返费耶特维尔。 

 【信号】 题干时间词原样出现 。录音开头 In less than a month 与题干 in less than a month 用词完全一致，这种"题干时间状语在原文原样响起"就是最强的定位信号，听到它，紧跟其后的主语就是答案所在。 

 【替换】 the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return ↔ The opening of the Special Olympics Spring Games. 重返即开赛 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 录音确实念到了 Methodist University（卫理公会大学），A 就把这个原词捡来编出 The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University."百年校庆"，但原文只说赛事在该校举办，从没提任何校庆或"100th"，是典型听到地名就想选的原词陷阱。  借用原文：The event will take place at Methodist University. 

 B) 原词陷阱 录音说赛事是 coming back for the first time in five years（五年来首次回归），B 把 "five years" 这个原词改头换面成 The first important political event in the next five years.，既把"赛事"偷换成"政治大事"，又把"过去五年"扭成"未来五年"，是盗用数字+偷换概念的双重陷阱。  借用原文：The Games are coming back for the first time in five years. 

 D) 偷换概念 选项 The reunion of this year's Olympic gold medalists. 借了原文反复出现的 "Olympics" 来误导：原文是 Special Olympics（特殊奥林匹克/残障人士运动会），D 偷偷掐掉 "Special" 变成普通"Olympic gold medalists 金牌选手聚会"，原文从未提金牌选手聚会，属偷换概念。  借用原文：the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville

questions.prompt: What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see?
options: Volunteers visit the Games' website to sign up.
Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games.
Children play in a fun tent and enjoy themselves fully.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What did Benjamin Kowalczyk say is rewarding to see? 

 【翻译】 Benjamin Kowalczyk 说看到什么令人欣慰? 
 A)  志愿者访问运动会网站报名参加。 
 B)  有特殊需要的运动员在运动会上取得胜利。 
 C)  组织者为运动会投入他们的时间和精力。 
 D)  孩子们在趣味帐篷里玩耍并尽情享受。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games. 
 【定位】 P2 Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games. 
 Kowalczyk 说，看到有特殊需求的运动员在赛事中取得胜利，是很有意义、很值得的。 

 【信号】 题干rewarding原话再现 。录音 Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see 把题干里的人名和评价词 "rewarding" 原样念出，这是"人物+评价词"双重信号，听到它就知道接下来 "to see" 后面那件事正是答案承载句。 

 【替换】 athletes with special needs triumph in the Games ↔ Athletes with special needs triumph in the Games. 评价词后内容直接对应 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 录音第三段确有 visit the Games' website to sign up，A 把这句原词整段搬来，但那是给"想当志愿者的人"的报名指引，不是 Kowalczyk "觉得值得一看"的事，盗用原词却答非所问。  借用原文：Organizers encourage them to visit the Games' website to sign up. 

 C) 张冠李戴 选项 Organizers devote their time and energy to the Games. 看似贴合主题，但原文 Kowalczyk 评"值得"的是运动员取胜，并没说"组织者投入时间精力"这件事值得看；原文只说想帮忙的人可去志愿，把评价对象悄悄换成了组织者，属张冠李戴+未提及。  借用原文：it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games 

 D) 原词陷阱 录音第二段确实念了 There will also be a fun tent for children.，D 把 "fun tent/children" 这组原词捡来，但那只是顺带交代赛事设施，Kowalczyk 的 "rewarding" 评价根本没落在孩子玩耍上，是听到原词就想选的原词陷阱。  借用原文：There will also be a fun tent for children.

questions.prompt: What has the German supermarket been ordered to do?
options: Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits.
Change the wrapping of its commodities.
Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss.
Defend itself in the country's commercial court.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What has the German supermarket been ordered to do? 

 【翻译】 这家德国超市被要求做什么? 
 A)  销毁其仿制的巧克力兔子。 
 B)  更改其商品的包装。 
 C)  赔偿瑞士制造商的损失。 
 D)  在该国商事法院为自己辩护。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits. 
 【定位】 P1 A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy its chocolate rabbits after it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer. 
 一家德国超市在与一家瑞士巧克力制造商的官司中败诉后，被勒令销毁其巧克力兔子。 

 【信号】 命令信号 ordered to 。答案句的信号是 has been ordered to destroy，ordered to 正是题干 been ordered to 的呼应，这种表命令、判决的短语就是答案落点，听到立刻锁定其后的动作。 

 【替换】 destroy its chocolate rabbits ↔ Destroy its imitation chocolate rabbits. 近乎同表述加补词 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 选项 Change the wrapping of its commodities. 借用了原文后文反复提到的 wrapper（包装），但原文从没要求超市改包装，命令是销毁，属听到 wrapping 就想选的原词陷阱。  借用原文：The colour of the wrapper is similar 

 C) 原词陷阱 选项 Compensate for the Swiss manufacturer's loss. 拼用了原文的 Swiss manufacturer 和 lost（败诉），但原文判的是销毁，从未提赔偿损失，是把熟词重组出的假动作。  借用原文：it lost a court battle with a Swiss chocolate manufacturer 

 D) 原词陷阱 选项 Defend itself in the country's commercial court. 借了原文的 commercial court，但那是去年商业法院的旧判决场景，本题命令是销毁兔子，并非要超市去出庭辩护。  借用原文：overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court

questions.prompt: What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question?
options: It could be rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket.
It could be reshaped into animals other than rabbits.
It could be resold cheaper to avoid waste.
It could be reused in other products.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What did Switzerland's highest court suggest about the chocolate in question? 

 【翻译】 瑞士最高法院对有关巧克力提出了什么建议? 
 A)  它可以被重新包装并由廉价超市出售。 
 B)  它可以被重新塑造成兔子以外的动物。 
 C)  它可以以更低价格转售以避免浪费。 
 D)  它可以在其他产品中重新使用。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） It could be reused in other products. 
 【定位】 P3 It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted. It could be melted for use in other products. 
 法院下令销毁所有仿制兔子，但建议巧克力不必浪费，可以熔化后用于其他产品。 

 【信号】 转折 but 后是真意 。答案句信号是转折词 but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted，but 前讲销毁、but 后才是对巧克力的建议，转折之后才是落点，这正呼应题干的 suggest。 

 【替换】 melted for use in other products ↔ It could be reused in other products. 熔化再用即重复使用 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项 rewrapped and sold by the budget supermarket 搬来原文的 budget supermarket，但原文建议是熔化再用，从没说重新包装由该超市出售，是熟词拼出的假处置。  借用原文：a similar product sold by the budget supermarket 

 B) 原词陷阱 选项 reshaped into animals other than rabbits 借了原文 rabbits 一词臆造出改造成别的动物，原文只说熔化用于其他产品，并未提改塑成动物。  借用原文：all the imitation rabbits be destroyed 

 C) 原词陷阱 选项 resold cheaper to avoid waste 借了原文 needn't be wasted 中的 waste 概念，但原文是熔化再用以避免浪费，不是降价转售，处置动作被偷换。  借用原文：the chocolate needn't be wasted

questions.prompt: Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling?
options: To be fair to the German supermarkets.
To protect chocolate retailers' interests.
To boost the growth of the chocolate industry.
To prevent consumers' possible confusion.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why did Switzerland's highest court overturn the commercial court's ruling? 

 【翻译】 瑞士最高法院为什么推翻商事法院的裁决? 
 A)  为了对德国超市公平。 
 B)  为了保护巧克力零售商的利益。 
 C)  为了促进巧克力行业的增长。 
 D)  为了防止消费者可能产生的混淆。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） To prevent consumers' possible confusion. 
 【定位】 P4 It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers. 
 法院表示，尽管两种产品之间存在一些差异，但仍有可能让消费者产生混淆。 

 【信号】 让步转折露真因 。答案句信号是让步结构 even though there are some differences...there was still the possibility of confusion，even though 让一步、but/still 后才是真正理由——担心消费者混淆，这就是推翻判决的原因。 

 【替换】 the possibility of confusion for consumers ↔ To prevent consumers' possible confusion. 存在混淆即为防混淆 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 选项 To be fair to the German supermarkets. 借了原文反复出现的 German supermarket，但原文推翻原判恰恰对超市不利，目的是防混淆而非对超市公平，方向相反。  借用原文：A German supermarket has been ordered to destroy 

 B) 偷换概念 选项 To protect chocolate retailers' interests. 把原文的 consumers（消费者）偷换成 retailers（零售商），原文明说担心的是消费者混淆，保护对象被换了一方。  借用原文：the possibility of confusion for consumers 

 C) 未提及 选项 To boost the growth of the chocolate industry. 借了反复出现的 chocolate，但原文从未提推动巧克力行业发展这一目的，是凭熟词臆造的目的。

questions.prompt: What does the man request the woman to do?
options: Return the handbook to him.
Make a vegetable dish.
Pass a book to him.
Meet his sister's boyfriend.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the man request the woman to do? 

 【翻译】 男士要求女士做什么? 
 A)  把手册还给他。 
 B)  做一道蔬菜菜肴。 
 C)  把一本书递给他。 
 D)  见见他姐姐的男朋友。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） Pass a book to him. 
 【定位】 P1 Can you please hand me that book over there? 
 你能把那边那本书递给我吗？ 

 【信号】 请求句 Can you please... 。答案句的信号是请求口吻 Can you please hand me that book over there?，Can you please 一出，后面跟的动作 hand me that book 就是男的请女的做的事，这正是"做什么"题要锁定的落点。 

 【替换】 hand me that book ↔ Pass a book to him. hand 与 pass 同义换词 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 A 的 Return the handbook to him. 用 handbook 蹭录音里的 hand me that book 的发音（hand...book），听着像，但录音说的是 hand（递）+ book（书），不是 handbook（手册），更没有 return（还）的意思。  借用原文：hand me that book 

 B) 答非所问 B 的 Make a vegetable dish. 用了录音 making a winter bean salad 里的做素菜原词，但做菜是男的自己"I need to make"，不是请女的做，答非所问。  借用原文：I need to make a lot of vegetable dishes 

 D) 原词陷阱 D 的 Meet his sister's boyfriend. 取自录音 My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner 的原词，但那只是交代背景（男友要来吃饭），并非男的请女的去见他。  借用原文：My sister's boyfriend is coming over for dinner

questions.prompt: What does the woman say about eating vegetables only?
options: It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet.
It would reduce one's protein intake.
It would do harm to one's muscles.
It doesn't sound practical for her.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the woman say about eating vegetables only? 

 【翻译】 关于只吃蔬菜,女士是怎么说的? 
 A)  这似乎不是均衡的饮食。 
 B)  这会减少一个人的蛋白质摄入。 
 C)  这会对一个人的肌肉造成伤害。 
 D)  这对她来说听起来不实际。 

 【答案】 A （态度观点题） It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet. 
 【定位】 P2 He only eats vegetables, no meat? That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet. 
 他只吃菜、不吃肉？那听起来不像是很均衡的饮食啊。 

 【信号】 评价句 That doesn't sound like... 。答案信号是女的抛出的总评价 That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet，doesn't sound like 是直接表态，这是她对"只吃素"的核心判断，后面 protein、muscles 都是她为这个判断补的理由。 

 【替换】 That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet ↔ It doesn't seem to be a balanced diet. sound like 换 seem to be 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 B 的 It would reduce one's protein intake. 蹭了录音 How can he get enough protein? 的 protein 原词，但女的只是反问"怎么获取足够蛋白质"来支撑她的判断，并没下"会减少蛋白质摄入"的结论。  借用原文：How can he get enough protein? 

 C) 原词陷阱 C 的 It would do harm to one's muscles. 借用录音 strengthen his muscles 的 muscles 原词，但女的是问"他怎么练肌肉"，并没说"会伤肌肉"，属于无中生有地拔高。  借用原文：strengthen his muscles 

 D) 偷换概念 D 的 It doesn't sound practical for her. 套用了录音 sound 的口吻，但女的评价的是"这饮食不均衡"，从没说"对她本人不实际"，把评判对象悄悄换成了"对她"。  借用原文：That doesn't sound like a very balanced diet

questions.prompt: Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian?
options: To improve his health.
To protect animal rights.
To follow a trendy lifestyle.
To stick to his religious belief.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why does the boyfriend of the man's sister choose to be a vegetarian? 

 【翻译】 男士的姐姐的男朋友为什么选择成为素食主义者? 
 A)  为了改善他的健康。 
 B)  为了保护动物权利。 
 C)  为了追随时尚的生活方式。 
 D)  为了坚持他的宗教信仰。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） To protect animal rights. 
 【定位】 P5 He's an animal activist. He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals. 
 他是个动物保护活动者。他一向很敏感，对动物充满同情。 

 【信号】 亮明身份句 He's an animal activist 。答案信号是男的直接亮出男友的身份与立场 He's an animal activist，紧接 sympathizes with animals。原因题里这种"He's a + 身份/立场"的句子，往往就是动机所在——他吃素是因为他是动物保护者。 

 【替换】 He's an animal activist ↔ To protect animal rights. 身份具体说法换成概括目的 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 A 的 To improve his health. 蹭了录音 health condition 的 health 原词，但那是女的列举可能原因时随口提的选项之一，录音随后明确否掉、给出的真实原因是动物保护，不是健康。  借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle? 

 C) 原词陷阱 C 的 To follow a trendy lifestyle. 借用录音 lifestyle 原词，但这同样只是女的列举的待选项之一，男的回答里根本没提"赶潮流"，是答非所问。  借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle? 

 D) 原词陷阱 D 的 To stick to his religious belief. 用了录音 religion 原词，且"宗教吃素"最符合日常常识，最易被默认选中；但录音明说原因是动物保护，宗教只是女的列举的可能性之一，并非答案。  借用原文：Is it his religion, health condition, or lifestyle?

questions.prompt: On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation?
options: The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks.
The necessity of having zoos and eating meat.
The gloomy environments animals are kept in.
The urgency of joining an animal rights group.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 On what point does the man agree with the woman at the end of the conversation? 

 【翻译】 在对话结束时,男士在哪一点上同意女士的观点? 
 A)  海豚在公园里遭受的折磨和痛苦。 
 B)  拥有动物园和吃肉的必要性。 
 C)  动物被饲养的阴暗环境。 
 D)  加入动物权利组织的紧迫性。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） The necessity of having zoos and eating meat. 
 【定位】 P6 W: Not all zoos and animal parks have the most favorable conditions, but without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals and their environments. Besides, I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game. M: Honestly, I agree. 
 女：并不是所有动物园和动物公园条件都最理想，但要是没有它们，就没法了解动物和它们的生存环境了。再说，我可舍不得放弃看棒球赛时来一根热狗。男：说实话，我同意。 

 【信号】 赞同信号 Honestly, I agree 。答案信号是男的结尾的明确赞同 Honestly, I agree，它指向的是女的紧挨着说的两点——动物园有存在的必要 without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals 和不愿放弃吃热狗（肉）I could ever give up a good hot dog。赞同句认同的就是这两点合起来的立场。 

 【替换】 without them it just wouldn't be feasible to learn about animals ↔ The necessity of having zoos and eating meat. 没了就不行 = 有必要 
 I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog ↔ eating meat 舍不得放弃热狗 = 要吃肉 

 【排除】 A) 张冠李戴 A 的 The torture and distress dolphins suffer in parks. 几乎照搬录音 the torture of dolphins in sea parks 与 causes them great distress 的原词，但那是男友（动物活动家）的立场，不是男女二人结尾达成的共识，张冠李戴。  借用原文：the torture of dolphins in sea parks 

 C) 原词陷阱 C 的 The gloomy environments animals are kept in. 蹭录音 That's a little gloomy 的 gloomy 原词，但 gloomy 是女的形容男友说法"有点令人沮丧"，并非两人一致认同"动物处境阴郁"，答非所问。  借用原文：That's a little gloomy 

 D) 原词陷阱 D 的 The urgency of joining an animal rights group. 借用录音 his local animal rights group 的 animal rights group 原词，但录音只是说男友是该组织发言人，根本没提"加入组织的紧迫性"，属凭空编造。  借用原文：He's the spokesperson for his local animal rights group

questions.prompt: What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting?
options: The part about getting over jetlag.
The part about air travel in the past.
The part about not eating on board the plane.
The part about avoiding sleeping on the plane.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What part of the TV program does the man say was interesting? 

 【翻译】 男士说电视节目的哪部分内容很有趣? 
 A)  关于克服时差反应的部分。 
 B)  关于过去航空旅行的部分。 
 C)  关于不在飞机上进食的部分。 
 D)  关于避免在飞机上睡觉的部分。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） The part about getting over jetlag. 
 【定位】 P2 The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting. 
 关于克服时差的那一部分很有趣。 

 【信号】 被问者男士的直接应答 + 评价词 interesting 。本题问的是男士，男士开口的 The part about overcoming jetlag was interesting. 就是被问者的直接应答，句中 interesting 与题干 interesting 完全对应，是把这句锁成答案句的信号。 

 【替换】 overcoming jetlag ↔ getting over jetlag 同义短语替换 overcome=get over 

 【排除】 B) 未提及 The part about air travel in the past 里 air travel 是整段对话的大话题词，听着耳熟，但男士说有趣的是克服时差那部分，"过去的航空旅行"录音并未作为有趣的一部分提到，属拿大话题词凑出的诱选。 
 C) 原词陷阱 not eating on board the plane 盗用了录音 not eating for the entire journey 这个原词内容，但那是男士转述"专家推荐"的建议、且他说的是"surprised（吃惊）"，并非回答"哪部分有趣"。听到 not eating 就选即落陷阱。  借用原文：the expert recommended not eating for the entire journey 

 D) 原词陷阱 avoiding sleeping on the plane 盗用录音 avoiding sleeping on the plane 的原词，但这与 C 一样属男士转述的专家建议、令他吃惊的内容，并不是他点名"有趣"的那部分（有趣的是克服时差整块），属原词陷阱。  借用原文：avoiding sleeping on the plane

questions.prompt: What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance?
options: Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone.
Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger.
Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts.
Try following the advice given by the expert on the show.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the man say he will do next time he flies a long distance? 

 【翻译】 男士说他下次长途飞行时会做什么? 
 A)  小睡一会儿以适应新时区。 
 B)  像平常一样进餐以避免饥饿。 
 C)  专注阅读专家推荐的文章。 
 D)  尝试遵循节目中专家给出的建议。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） Try following the advice given by the expert on the show. 
 【定位】 P4 the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance. 
 节目里的那位专家确实引用了支持她建议的研究，所以我想下次长途飞行时我会试试看。 

 【信号】 表打算的信号 I'll give it a try + 时间短语 next time 。I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance 里的 I'll give it a try 是典型"打算"信号，又带 next time I fly a long distance 与题干时间完全吻合，是锁定答案句的双重信号。 

 【替换】 give it a try ↔ Try following the advice give it a try=try following，照建议试一试 
 the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations ↔ the advice given by the expert on the show her recommendations=the advice，同为专家建议 

 【排除】 A) 张冠李戴 Take a nap to adjust to a new time zone 盗用了女士那句 taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone 的原词，但那是女士转述"过去文章"的主张，且专家恰恰建议"不要睡"，并非男士下次要做的事，属张冠李戴。  借用原文：taking a nap on the plane was the best way to adjust to a new time zone 

 B) 张冠李戴 Have meals as usual to stay away from hunger 对应女士读到的旧观点 it was important not to miss meals，而男士打算照的是"专家建议"，专家主张是 not eating——男士要做的恰与 B 相反，属张冠李戴兼与原文相反。  借用原文：it was important not to miss meals 

 C) 偷换概念 Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts 把录音里的 expert 与 W 提到的 an article on the subject 拼在一起，造出"读专家推荐的文章"，但男士说的是 give it a try（照建议试做），并非去读文章，属偷换概念。  借用原文：I read an article on the subject in the past

questions.prompt: Why does the woman think she is lucky?
options: She does not have any problem flying.
She can spend a lot of time vacationing.
She does not have to worry about jetlag.
She has been well treated when traveling.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why does the woman think she is lucky? 

 【翻译】 女士为什么认为自己很幸运? 
 A)  她乘飞机没有任何问题。 
 B)  她可以花大量时间度假。 
 C)  她不必担心时差反应。 
 D)  她在旅行时得到了很好的待遇。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） She does not have to worry about jetlag. 
 【定位】 P5 she did say that jetlag often becomes more of a problem after 40, so I guess I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well. 
 她确实说过时差在 40 岁以后往往会变成更大的问题，所以我想我算幸运，因为我还能很好地适应不同的时区。 

 【信号】 标志词 I'm lucky + that 引出理由 。I'm lucky that I can still adjust to different time zones well 里 I'm lucky 直接对应题干 lucky，紧跟的 that 从句给出理由——这个"幸运 + that 理由"结构就是答案句信号。 

 【替换】 I can still adjust to different time zones well ↔ She does not have to worry about jetlag 能适应时区=不必担心时差，肯否定转换 

 【排除】 A) 与原文相反 She does not have any problem flying 与原文相反：女士紧接着说 My problem is I'm afraid to fly，明说自己有怕飞的问题，所以"飞行无问题"是反着说的，且她的幸运也不是指这点。  借用原文：My problem is I'm afraid to fly 

 B) 未提及 She can spend a lot of time vacationing 里 vacation 蹭了后文男士提到的 our family vacations，但那是男士讲自家度假方式，女士的幸运与"能度很多假"毫无关系，属未提及。  借用原文：our family vacations were always by car or train 

 D) 未提及 She has been well treated when traveling"旅行中受优待"在整段录音里没有任何对应内容，与女士的幸运（能适应时区）也不搭，属凭空捏造。

questions.prompt: Why does the woman think the problem of being afraid to fly deserves attention?
options: It has caused heavy losses to many airlines.
It impacts female travelers more seriously.
It has long been ignored by many experts.
It affects twenty-five percent of people.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why does the woman think the problem of being afraid to fly deserves attention? 

 【翻译】 女士为什么认为害怕乘飞机的问题值得关注? 
 A)  它给许多航空公司造成了重大损失。 
 B)  它对女性旅客的影响更严重。 
 C)  它长期以来被许多专家忽视。 
 D)  它影响百分之二十五的人。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） It affects twenty-five percent of people. 
 【定位】 P9 Actually, it was a quarter of people, so the problem really is widespread and deserves attention. 
 其实是四分之一的人，所以这个问题确实很普遍，值得关注。 

 【信号】 纠正信号 Actually + 数字 a quarter，且与题干 deserves attention 同词 。女士用 Actually, it was a quarter of people 纠正男士先前说的数字，so the problem really is widespread and deserves attention 里 deserves attention 与题干同词——Actually 的纠正语气与同词回扣是双重信号。 

 【替换】 a quarter of people ↔ twenty-five percent of people a quarter=25%，分数与百分比换算 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 It has caused heavy losses to many airlines 蹭了全篇的 air travel/航空话题，但"给航空公司造成巨额亏损"录音从未提及，女士给的理由是比例之高，不是公司亏损，属未提及。 
 B) 未提及 It impacts female travelers more seriously 凭空加了"female travelers、more seriously"的范围与程度，录音只说影响四分之一的人、并未区分性别，属无中生有地偷加范围程度。 
 C) 与原文相反 It has long been ignored by many experts 借了对话反复出现的 expert 设原词诱惑，但录音说的是这问题 deserves attention（值得关注），并未说"长期被专家忽视"，方向相反，属与原文相反兼借词诱选。  借用原文：deserves attention

questions.prompt: What does the speaker think is the best way to get started in user experience design?
options: Learning from skilled designers.
Obtaining real-world experience.
Joining a 6-month training camp.
Anticipating actual challenges.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the speaker think is the best way to get started in user experience design? 

 【翻译】 演讲者认为入门用户体验设计的最佳方式是什么? 
 A)  向熟练的设计师学习。 
 B)  获得真实世界的经验。 
 C)  参加为期6个月的培训营。 
 D)  预见实际挑战。 

 【答案】 B （细节题） Obtaining real-world experience. 
 【定位】 P1 The most common question I'm asked always centers around how to get started in user experience design, to which my response is always that nothing can substitute real-world experience. 
 别人最常问我的问题总是围绕怎么入门用户体验设计，对此我的回答始终是：没有什么能替代真实世界的经验。 

 【信号】 nothing can substitute抬高某项 。答案信号是这句里的 nothing can substitute real-world experience（没有什么能替代真实世界的经验）——nothing can substitute 是把某一项捧到唯一、最高位置的强调说法，凡听到这种把别的全比下去的句式，那句就是答案句。 

 【替换】 nothing can substitute real-world experience ↔ Obtaining real-world experience. 唯一不可替代等于最佳 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 Learning from skilled designers. 听起来很合理，但录音通篇没说过要向熟练的设计师学，它是凭常识脑补的入门方式，原文无对应。 
 C) 原词陷阱 Joining a 6-month training camp. 盗用了录音第三段的原词 6-month training camp，但原文是把训练营当成学不到适应力的反面例子来说的，并非入门的最佳方式，属于听到原词就想选的陷阱。  借用原文：much less in a 6-month training camp 

 D) 原词陷阱 Anticipating actual challenges. 借用了第二段原词 actual challenges，但原文说的是高等教育无法让你为真实挑战做好准备，并没说入门的最佳方式是去预判挑战，选项把原词搬过来又改了意思。  借用原文：it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say being effective requires?
options: Core skills.
Higher education.
Adaptability.
Capability.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What does the speaker say being effective requires? 

 【翻译】 演讲者说要有效需要什么? 
 A)  核心技能。 
 B)  高等教育。 
 C)  适应能力。 
 D)  能力。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） Adaptability. 
 【定位】 P3 Being effective requires adaptability — something you don't really learn in school, much less in a 6-month training camp. 
 要做到有效就需要适应力——这是你在学校里学不太到的东西，在六个月的训练营里就更别提了。 

 【信号】 requires直接点出条件 。答案信号就是题干原话在录音里几乎复现：Being effective requires adaptability，requires 后面紧跟的 adaptability 就是被点名的条件。这种题干和原文几乎同形、只差答案词的句子，是最直接的答案句信号。 

 【替换】 Being effective requires adaptability ↔ Adaptability. 原词同形直接对应 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 Core skills. 盗用了第二段原词 core skills，但原文说的是高等教育能帮你装备一些核心技能、随后却话锋一转说它不够，core skills 并不是 being effective 所需要的那样东西，属听到原词就想选的陷阱。  借用原文：Higher education is a great way to equip yourself with some core skills 

 B) 原词陷阱 Higher education. 盗用第二段原词 Higher education，但原文说高等教育不能让你应对真实挑战、是被往下压的一项，根本不是 being effective 所需，听到这个原词就选会掉坑。  借用原文：but it will not prepare you for actual challenges 

 D) 未提及 Capability. 和正确项 Adaptability. 一样以 -ability 结尾、长得像，是专为只听个相似尾音的考生设的形近干扰，但录音从没说 being effective 需要 capability。

questions.prompt: What can people do as long as they know their end goal and strive for it?
options: Start anywhere.
Face challenges.
Pursue roles in teams.
Follow their own path.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What can people do as long as they know their end goal and strive for it? 

 【翻译】 只要人们知道自己的最终目标并为之努力,他们能做什么? 
 A)  从任何地方开始。 
 B)  面对挑战。 
 C)  在团队中追求角色。 
 D)  遵循自己的道路。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） Start anywhere. 
 【定位】 P4 You can start anywhere as long as you know your end goal and you commit to actively pursuing opportunities to learn and grow along the way. 
 只要你清楚自己的终极目标，并且愿意一路上主动去追寻学习和成长的机会，你可以从任何地方起步。 

 【信号】 as long as条件句的主句 。答案信号是这句的结构 You can start anywhere as long as you know your end goal——as long as 是题干照搬的条件信号词，它前面的主句 You can start anywhere 就是回答能做什么的部分，条件句的主句才是答案落点。 

 【替换】 You can start anywhere ↔ Start anywhere. 主句原话浓缩为动词短语 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 Face challenges. 里的 challenges 来自前文（如第二段说的 actual challenges、第四段说团队能 challenge me），但 as long as 那句答案句里说的是 start anywhere，不是面对挑战，选项搬了别处的原词来凑。  借用原文：roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me 

 C) 张冠李戴 Pursue roles in teams. 盗用第四段原词 pursue roles within teams，但那是作者讲自己当年的经历（他自己去团队里求角色），不是回答只要知道目标就能做什么，属张冠李戴式的原词陷阱。  借用原文：to continue to pursue roles within teams that I knew could teach and challenge me 

 D) 与原文相反 Follow their own path. 借用第四段 my path 的说法，但原文是作者说我不认为自己这条路是唯一的，恰恰是不主张人人照走他的路，选项却说去走自己的路，与原文倾向相反。  借用原文：That's not to say that I think my path is the only one.

questions.prompt: Why did the school principal ask what needed to change?
options: To respond actively to students' requests.
To engage students more in their learning.
To enable teachers to interact more with their students.
To allow students more freedom in their academic work.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why did the school principal ask what needed to change? 

 【翻译】 校长为什么要问需要改变什么？ 
 A)  积极回应学生的要求。 
 B)  让学生更多地参与到学习中。 
 C)  使教师能够更多地与学生互动。 
 D)  让学生在学业上拥有更多自由。 

 【答案】 B （目的题） To engage students more in their learning. 
 【定位】 P1 When planning for this year, our principal asked what needed to change to engage students more in their learning. 
 在筹划今年的工作时，我们校长问需要改变什么，好让学生更投入到自己的学习中。 

 【信号】 目的状语 to engage… 直接给出动机 。句中 to engage students more in their learning 是"为了…"的目的状语，紧跟在校长发问之后，正是他发问的目的所在，是这句成为答案句的信号。 

 【替换】 to engage students more in their learning ↔ To engage students more in their learning. 几乎原句搬到选项 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 选项说"主动回应学生的请求"，但录音里是校长主动发问、要让学生更投入，没有"回应学生请求"一说，方向不符。 
 C) 原词陷阱 选项把焦点说成"让老师与学生更多互动"，盗用了录音反复出现的 teachers、students，但校长的目的是让"学生"更投入学习，不是促进师生互动，偷换了主体与重点。  借用原文：to engage students more in their learning 

 D) 过度推断 选项说"给学生更多学业自由"，录音目的句只讲 engage（投入），从未提 freedom（自由），是把投入度过度引申成自由度。

questions.prompt: What has flexible seating meant at the speaker's school?
options: Using new furniture to create a comfortable environment.
Shifting from traditional teaching to task-based learning.
Adopting a variety of different seating options.
Rearranging most traditional chairs and desks.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What has flexible seating meant at the speaker's school? 

 【翻译】 灵活座位在说话者的学校意味着什么？ 
 A)  使用新家具营造舒适的环境。 
 B)  从传统教学转向基于任务的学习。 
 C)  采用多种不同的座位选择。 
 D)  重新摆放大部分传统的椅子和课桌。 

 【答案】 C （细节题） Adopting a variety of different seating options. 
 【定位】 P3 For us, flexible seating has meant removing most of the traditional chairs and desks and introducing a variety of different seating options to promote student engagement. 
 对我们来说，灵活座位意味着撤掉大部分传统桌椅，引入多种不同的座位选择，以促进学生投入。 

 【信号】 下定义信号 has meant 。句中 flexible seating has meant 是"在本校它意味着什么"的下定义信号，与题干 has meant 完全对应，定义内容紧随其后，是答案句的标志。 

 【替换】 introducing a variety of different seating options ↔ Adopting a variety of different seating options. introducing 与 Adopting 同义替换 

 【排除】 A) 未提及 选项说"用新家具营造舒适环境"，录音定义句讲的是 promote student engagement（促进投入），从未提 comfortable（舒适），属凭空添加。 
 B) 偷换概念 选项说"从传统教学转向任务式学习"，录音只说从 teacher-focused 转向 student-focused，并未出现 task-based learning（任务式学习）这一说法，偷换了概念。  借用原文：a shift in practice from being teacher-focused to student-focused learning 

 D) 原词陷阱 选项"重排大部分传统桌椅"盗用了录音的 traditional chairs and desks，但录音是 removing（撤掉）这些桌椅再引入多样座位，不是 Rearranging（重排），只截了动作的一半且改了动词。  借用原文：removing most of the traditional chairs and desks

questions.prompt: What has flexible seating brought about at the speaker's school?
options: A win for all people involved.
A strengthened effect of its discipline.
A harmonious relationship among its students.
A change to teachers' opinion of their students.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What has flexible seating brought about at the speaker's school? 

 【翻译】 灵活座位在说话者的学校带来了什么？ 
 A)  对所有相关人员都有益。 
 B)  加强了纪律效果。 
 C)  学生之间关系和谐。 
 D)  改变了教师对学生的看法。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） A win for all people involved. 
 【定位】 P6 From our experience so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning, while reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions. It is a win for all concerned. 
 从我们目前的经验看，灵活座位增强了学生对空间的归属感和学习投入，同时降低了学生的脱离感和纪律处分的发生率。这对所有相关方都是一种共赢。 

 【信号】 结尾总结句 It is a win for all concerned 。末段 It is a win for all concerned 是带总结语气的收束句，把前面列举的好处一句话归纳为"对所有人都是共赢"，是结果题最该锁的落点。 

 【替换】 It is a win for all concerned ↔ A win for all people involved. all concerned 与 all people involved 同义 

 【排除】 B) 原词陷阱 选项说"纪律效果增强"，盗用录音的 disciplinary，但录音是 reducing…disciplinary actions（减少纪律处分），方向相反；且只取纪律一项，丢了"共赢"的全面性。  借用原文：reducing rates of student disengagement and disciplinary actions 

 C) 原词陷阱 选项说"学生之间关系融洽"，盗用了高频词 students，但录音讲的是学生对空间的归属感与投入，从未提学生彼此之间的 harmonious relationship（融洽关系）。  借用原文：enhances student ownership of space and engagement in learning 

 D) 未提及 选项说"改变了老师对学生的看法"，录音末段只讲对学生投入、纪律的成效与"共赢"，并未提到老师对学生看法的任何改变。

questions.prompt: Why were dozens of British students sent home on Tuesday?
options: They weren't informed of the school's updated rules.
They arrived late for their first day of school.
They answered their headteacher's email in an impolite way.
They didn't wear the shoes required by the school's new policy.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 Why were dozens of British students sent home on Tuesday? 

 【翻译】 为什么数十名英国学生在周二被送回家？ 
 A)  他们没有被告知学校更新的规定。 
 B)  他们在开学第一天迟到了。 
 C)  他们以不礼貌的方式回复了校长的电子邮件。 
 D)  他们没有穿学校新政策要求的鞋子。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） They didn't wear the shoes required by the school's new policy. 
 【定位】 P1 About 30 students were turned away from Taverham High School in Norfolk, England. Headteacher, Dr Roger Harris, confirmed that this was due to a change in the school's uniform policy. 
 大约 30 名学生被英格兰诺福克的 Taverham 高中拒之门外。校长 Roger Harris 博士确认，这是由于学校校服政策的一项变动。 

 【信号】 因果信号 due to 。答案句里 this was due to a change in the school's uniform policy 的 "due to" 是明确的因果信号，它后面跟的"校服政策变动"就是被送回家的原因，正是 Why 题要抓的落点。 

 【替换】 a change in the school's uniform policy ↔ the shoes required by the school's new policy 概括换具体加同义改写 

 【排除】 A) 选项说学生"没被告知更新的规定"，但录音里校长明确说 he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June——是已经通知过的，选项把"通知过"反说成"没被告知"，方向相反。  借用原文：he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June 

 B) 录音只说这天是 their first day of school on Tuesday，提到了"开学第一天"，但从未说学生"迟到"；选项盗用了"first day"的时间背景，把原因编成"迟到"，原文没有依据。 
 C) 原词陷阱 录音提到校长是用 in an email in June 通知家长的，选项盗用"email"这个原词，编出"以不礼貌方式回复校长邮件"；原文只说校长发邮件通知，根本没说学生回邮件、更没说态度不礼貌。  借用原文：he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June

questions.prompt: What can the price of school uniforms spark among families in financial difficulty?
options: Riots.
Anger.
Disputes.
Panic.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What can the price of school uniforms spark among families in financial difficulty? 

 【翻译】 校服的价格会在经济困难的家庭中引发什么？ 
 A)  骚乱。 
 B)  愤怒。 
 C)  争议。 
 D)  恐慌。 

 【答案】 D （细节题） Panic. 
 【定位】 P2 The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living. 
 校服的价格会在那些在高生活成本中苦苦挣扎的家庭里激起恐慌。 

 【信号】 题干原词 spark 几乎原句重现 。答案句 The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families 与题干用词高度重合（price/spark/families），spark 紧跟的那个词 panic 就是被引发的反应，是定位信号。 

 【替换】 spark panic among families ↔ Panic. 原词直接对应 

 【排除】 A) Riots（骚乱）程度最重、最抓耳，但录音里从未出现"骚乱"；它是把"恐慌"夸大成"骚乱"的诱饵，原文无依据。 
 B) Anger（愤怒）听上去和"家长有意见"很搭，但原文 spark 后面接的是 panic 不是 anger；anger 是个貌似合理却没被念到的情绪词。 
 C) Disputes（争执/纠纷）也是一种貌似合理的负面反应，但原文激起的是 panic，并未提到"争执"，属没被念到的干扰项。

questions.prompt: What did the headteacher think of the school's new uniform rules?
options: They strengthened the school's discipline and order.
They improved student behavior and performance.
They enhanced the positive image of the school.
They rendered the school unique in the district.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What did the headteacher think of the school's new uniform rules? 

 【翻译】 校长如何看待学校的新校服规定？ 
 A)  它们加强了学校的纪律和秩序。 
 B)  它们改善了学生的行为和表现。 
 C)  它们提升了学校的正面形象。 
 D)  它们使学校在该地区独树一帜。 

 【答案】 B （态度观点题） They improved student behavior and performance. 
 【定位】 P3 Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior. 
 Harris 认为，更严格的校服规定改善了学生的成绩和行为。 

 【信号】 观点引导词 held that 。答案句 Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior 里的 "held that"（认为）是明确的观点信号，引出的正是校长本人的看法，是态度题的落点。 

 【替换】 improved student outcomes and behavior ↔ improved student behavior and performance 同义词替换 

 【排除】 A) 原词陷阱 录音里有 strengthened rules around school uniforms，"strengthened" 这个词真的念到了；选项 strengthened the school's discipline and order 盗用 strengthened，但把它的对象换成"纪律和秩序"——原文是"更严格的规定改善了成绩和行为"，strengthened 修饰的是 rules 而非 discipline，张冠李戴。  借用原文：strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior 

 C) "提升学校的正面形象"（positive image）听起来是个合理好处，但校长说的是改善"成绩和行为"，从未提到"形象"，原文无依据。 
 D) 录音第 4 段出现过 Private rental prices in Britain 等带 district/地区背景的经济描述（原文用 households/Britain），选项 rendered the school unique in the district 借"地区"这类背景感造出"让学校在本区独一无二"，但校长的观点里根本没说学校"独特"，属编造。

questions.prompt: What did Lucinda May have to do to buy her child the correct pair of shoes?
options: Turn to her parents for help.
Tighten her monthly budget.
Borrow £65 from her friend.
Postpone paying her other bills.
questions.explanation:
【题目】 What did Lucinda May have to do to buy her child the correct pair of shoes? 

 【翻译】 Lucinda May为了给孩子买到正确的鞋子必须做什么？ 
 A)  向她的父母求助。 
 B)  压缩她的月度预算。 
 C)  向她的朋友借65英镑。 
 D)  推迟支付她的其他账单。 

 【答案】 A （细节题） Turn to her parents for help. 
 【定位】 P5 Lucinda May, mum of a Taverham student, said that she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy her child the correct pair of shoes. 
 Taverham 一名学生的母亲 Lucinda May 说，她不得不向自己的父母要 65 英镑，来给孩子买那双符合要求的鞋。 

 【信号】 被问者的直接动作 had to ask 。答案句 she had to ask her parents for £65 to buy her child the correct pair of shoes 里的 "had to ask" 正是题干问的"不得不做的动作"，her parents 点明动作对象，是定位信号。 

 【替换】 ask her parents for £65 ↔ Turn to her parents for help 同义短语 + 概括化 

 【排除】 B) "缩紧月度预算"和第 4 段 many households are on tight budgets 的 "tight budgets" 背景相呼应，但那是说大环境下家庭预算紧，并非 May 本人"缩预算"这个动作；她的实际做法是向父母要钱。  借用原文：many households are on tight budgets 

 C) 偷换概念 金额 £65 是原文真念到的（ask her parents for £65），选项 Borrow £65 from her friend. 保住了对的金额却把对象从"her parents"偷换成"her friend"，动作也从"ask"变"borrow"，对象错了。  借用原文：she had to ask her parents for £65 

 D) "推迟支付其他账单"和第 4 段 Soaring energy bills have made things worse. 里的 bills 沾边，但原文只说能源账单让情况更糟，从没说 May"推迟付账单"；这是借 bills 一词编出的动作。
